data.notes: March 2026 in New York combined a Lower East Side discovery festival, arena-scale pop and R&B tours, and strong Brooklyn/Queens electronic programming.

events.title: The New Colossus Festival 2026
events.summary: The New Colossus Festival returned as a six-day Lower East Side showcase for emerging international artists, with music programming alongside its Colossal Conversations conference component.

events.title: Love Rocks NYC 2026
events.summary: The 10th annual Love Rocks NYC benefit concert for God’s Love We Deliver took place at Beacon Theatre, with an all-star bill including Mary J. Blige, Hozier, Jon Batiste, Nile Rodgers & CHIC, Paul Simon, Trombone Shorty and Warren Haynes.

events.title: PHOTON: Ben Klock, Chlär live, Fadi Mohem, NEUX
events.summary: Ben Klock brought his PHOTON audio-visual techno concept to Knockdown Center, joined by Chlär live, Fadi Mohem and NEUX.

events.title: Silence Wang: The Rise of Romance World Tour
events.summary: Chinese pop artist Silence Wang brought The Rise of Romance World Tour to Barclays Center for two Brooklyn dates on March 7 and 8.

events.title: Tedeschi Trucks Band Beacon Theatre Residency
events.summary: Tedeschi Trucks Band returned to the Beacon Theatre for a March residency; this representative March 13 performance was part of the band’s 10-show run at the venue.

events.title: New Edition: The New Edition Way Tour
events.summary: New Edition brought The New Edition Way Tour to Barclays Center with Toni Braxton and Boyz II Men.

events.title: Lady Gaga: The MAYHEM Ball
events.summary: Lady Gaga brought The MAYHEM Ball to Madison Square Garden for March 19 and 20 performances.

events.title: FKA twigs: Body High Tour
events.summary: FKA twigs brought the Body High Tour to Madison Square Garden with special guest Tokischa.

events.title: Cardi B: Little Miss Drama Tour
events.summary: Cardi B brought the Little Miss Drama Tour to Madison Square Garden for two March dates.

events.title: Pan-Pot, ONYVAA
events.summary: German techno duo Pan-Pot returned to Knockdown Center with ONYVAA, who made her Knockdown Center debut.

events.title: The Millennium Tour Presents: The Boys 4 Life Tour
events.summary: The Millennium Tour’s Boys 4 Life Tour came to Barclays Center with B2K, Bow Wow, Waka Flocka, Amerie, Yung Joc, B5, Crime Mob, Dem Franchize Boyz and Pretty Ricky.

events.title: Meshell Ndegeocello with Justin Hicks
events.summary: Winter Jazzfest presented Meshell Ndegeocello at Pioneer Works with Justin Hicks, after the show was moved from its original January date to March 29.
